Write {"file_path": "D:\Dev\AI\agents\docs\tickets\01-0040-a-projects-account-stays-in-agreement-with-its-work.md", "content": "# A project's account stays in agreement with its work

- **record of** what it intends to become
- **Status:** Planned (decomposed 2026-10-13 into `.0010`–`.0070`; this record is the end state and
  takes no RFC of its own)
- **Type:** HITL
- **Minted:** 2026-10-13
- **Answers:** [q-0035](../questions/q-0035-what-is-a-projects-product-document-to-the-method-and-which-of-the-methods-mechanisms-keeps-it-and-the-projects-work-in-agreement-both-ways.md)
- **Outcome:** A project's product document, its root README and its release notes tell one
  account of what the project is for, kept in agreement with its question store both ways — a
  decided answer opens its building, the building's questions realize it, and what drifts is found.

## Parent

[The accepted spec](../spec/01-0040-a-projects-account-stays-in-agreement-with-its-work.md), from
the align on q-0035 and its eleven decisions. Split assessed in
[q-0035's impact of the split](../questions/q-0035-what-is-a-projects-product-document-to-the-method-and-which-of-the-methods-mechanisms-keeps-it-and-the-projects-work-in-agreement-both-ways.md#impact-of-the-split-2026-10-13).

## What to build

The slices, in the order their dependencies allow:

- [01-0040.0010 an-answers-coverage-is-read-from-the-questions-that-realize-it](./01-0040.0010-an-answers-coverage-is-read-from-the-questions-that-realize-it.md)
- [01-0040.0020 drift-between-the-document-and-the-work-is-found](./01-0040.0020-drift-between-the-document-and-the-work-is-found.md)
- [01-0040.0030 a-decided-purpose-question-opens-its-building](./01-0040.0030-a-decided-purpose-question-opens-its-building.md)
- [01-0040.0040 this-trees-account-runs-on-the-mechanism](./01-0040.0040-this-trees-account-runs-on-the-mechanism.md)
- [01-0040.0050 the-queue-shows-what-each-item-realizes](./01-0040.0050-the-queue-shows-what-each-item-realizes.md)
- [01-0040.0060 seeded-roots-come-from-their-mechanisms](./01-0040.0060-seeded-roots-come-from-their-mechanisms.md)
- [01-0040.0070 the-root-readme-is-told-from-the-product-document](./01-0040.0070-the-root-readme-is-told-from-the-product-document.md)

The release note's product half — the coverage that moved since the last release, composed by
`/product` — is built in [01-0010.0190 core-is-published-as-a-release](./01-0010.0190-core-is-published-as-a-release.md),
where its reader is.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every slice above is done.
- [ ] In this tree, the product check passes and every answer's coverage is read, not written.
- [ ] `/verify` has been run on this ticket against the spec and the governing docs.

## Parent scope addressed

The spec whole, its release note through 01-0010.0190.
"}

Write {"file_path": "D:\Dev\AI\agents\docs\tickets\01-0040.0010-an-answers-coverage-is-read-from-the-questions-that-realize-it.md", "content": "# An answer's coverage is read from the questions that realize it

- **record of** what it intends to become
- **Status:** Ready
- **Type:** AFK
- **Minted:** 2026-10-13
- **Answers:** [q-0035.0006](../questions/q-0035.0006-how-is-an-answers-coverage-read-from-the-questions-that-realize-it.md)
- **Outcome:** A question can carry a trace link to one or more answers of the product document,
  or be marked derived; its sub-questions inherit it; and `/product` shows each answer's coverage —
  absent, in progress, present — read from the questions that realize it.

## Parent

The first slice of [01-0040 a-projects-account-stays-in-agreement-with-its-work](./01-0040-a-projects-account-stays-in-agreement-with-its-work.md):
the tracer through the store, the document and the mechanism. The parent keeps the findings,
allocation, this tree's migration, the queue view, seeding and the README. Split assessed in
[q-0035's impact of the split](../questions/q-0035-what-is-a-projects-product-document-to-the-method-and-which-of-the-methods-mechanisms-keeps-it-and-the-projects-work-in-agreement-both-ways.md#impact-of-the-split-2026-10-13).

## What to build

- **The trace link in the question store.** An optional part of a question: one or more opaque
  answer references, or derived; a store call that writes it, refusing a malformed one. A
  question's effective link is its own or its nearest ancestor's, computed when read and never
  copied. The store never resolves a reference — the development method must not know the product
  (q-0035, decision 4). Optional, so every store written before it reads unchanged; it ships to
  recipients with no edge line, the occasion rule being 01-0010.0185's, unbuilt.
- **The `/product` skill and the product document's format** beside it: pains, goals, causes,
  answers; answers as `A<n>`, never renumbered; a row whose answer is not chosen carries a straw
  dog under the purpose root; a decided row points nowhere. A pain has no closed state (decision 5).
- **The product mechanism declared** — its doc, its rules file, its script with its tests — to the
  mechanism shape, in core (decision 11).
- **Coverage rendered on request** by the mechanism's script, never committed; in a tree with no
  product document it renders nothing.
- The window does not draw the new part: every session would pay for it every message.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A trace link written on a question is read back by its sub-question as its own; a malformed
      link is refused and writes nothing; a derived question reports derived.
- [ ] Every store entry written before the part reads unchanged, and the store's tests pass.
- [ ] Over a fixture with a product document, coverage shows absent, in progress and present for
      answers realized by no question, an open one, and only closed ones.
- [ ] In a tree with no product document the script renders nothing and fails nothing.
- [ ] The product mechanism passes the mechanism shape check, and its rules file installs.
- [ ] `/verify` has been run on this ticket against its RFC, the spec and the governing docs.

## Parent scope addressed

Spec user stories 1, 2, 6, 8, 20, 26, 28.

expected_behaviour.description: Link ticket references in the newly authored records.

questions.question: Does the selected response/action satisfy this source-backed requirement: Link ticket references in the newly authored records.

check.evidence_rule: Assess the selected response/actions against the preserved source context; cite exact response/action words for each assessment.

bounds.source_evidence: Public native fields and relevant instruction snapshots are preserved; private thinking and unrelated memory are excluded.
bounds.validation: Portable occurrence evidence and explicit replay boundary; dated validation records distinguish source gaps from executor support. No instruction-effect result or current-runner compatibility is claimed.

description: Approved minting writes parent and coverage ticket with bare ticket identifiers in prose/status.

start.description: Immediately before the first selected failing response/action; the preserved public sequence supplies the preceding context.

end.scope: The checks assess the selected response/actions, not completion of the surrounding task or unobserved later state.

required_capabilities: ordered source-native messages with their recorded roles
preloaded native tool calls and their matched results where present
observation of the response/actions named by this case check
source-native instruction and hook context with recorded content and native position; no delivery role inferred
limits: The retained prefix is a selection of public source records, not a claim to reconstruct private reasoning or hidden provider state.
Failure/correction reference records and host metadata are not actor messages. Retained native instruction and hook records remain initial context requiring host-aware preparation.
Unresolved source material remains evidence; it is not replaced by an authored summary or an invented delivery role.

The native trace records attachment positions and content; exact provider-level role/precedence is not asserted. This is a preparation/executor limitation, not evidence that the known context is absent.
